cohort: 6074 women who delivered at the Singapore General Hospital from January 2008 to December 2011
finding: Group 5 (previous CS, singleton, cephalic, ≥37 weeks) was the largest contributor to the overall CS rate, followed by Group 2 (previous CS, singleton, cephalic, ≥37 weeks) and Group 10 (singleton, breech, ≥37 weeks).
